description: This file defines a custom Swagger schema filter for an ASP.NET Core application, specifically removing the 'CorrelationId' property from OpenAPI schemas.

classes.name: CustomSchemaFilters
classes.description: Implements ISchemaFilter to customize OpenAPI schema generation by removing specific properties.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Removes the 'CorrelationId' property from the given OpenApiSchema if it exists.
